_comment: Add/remove projects freely — the site re-renders from this file on every load, nothing else needs touching. A project gets its own full-size section only if its 'id' is listed in the top-level 'featured' array below; every project (featured or not) also appears in the compact 'Everything, indexed' section. Order of the 'featured' array is the order those sections appear. See Configurations.md for full field reference.

projects.name: Thermite
projects.tagline: Cloud Rust compiler with no application server.
projects.description: Fe2O3 + 2Al -> Al2O3 + 2Fe + heat. Compiles Rust on GitHub's own hosted runners, in your account, on your quota, and hands you a binary for any of eleven targets -- optionally sealed end to end with a key only you hold. The site itself is a static page with no backend of its own.

patents.title: System and Method for Preventing Data Leakage — Data Leak Protection Technology
patents.abstract: Designed a self-protecting data leak prevention architecture that secures files using memory-hard and geo-bound encryption and environment-aware verification based on trusted system metadata. The system continues protecting data even after it leaves the owner’s environment, providing tamper detection, secure erasure, telemetry notifications, and configurable trust models for individual and enterprise deployments.

patents.title: System and Method for Restricting Malware-Based Attack — Anti-Ransomware Blockchain Architecture
patents.abstract: Designed an always-on, in-memory blockchain architecture to protect user data against crypto-ransomware. The system maintains a tamper-evident ledger of file operations using memory-hard proof-of-work validation, enabling rapid detection of unauthorized modifications while remaining resilient against attacks targeting conventional disk-based storage while enabling efficient recovery of protected data.
